results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued April 29, 2026
US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board | Al Jazeera
What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?

summary: FOMC April 29 2026: held funds rate at 3.5%-3.75%. Unusual 8-4 dissent. Inflation elevated partly from Middle East energy prices. Powell's likely final meeting as Fed Chair; leadership transition pending.
